acceptance.axes: 0..100, ticks every20; generated axis calibration; baseline and top actual solid outline, excluding highlights/cast shadows
acceptance.text: 测试数据; 甲20 乙70 丙40 丁90; 4 objects, no extra/missing category/value, correct order and bindings

aesthetics.material_recognizability: 0 absent,1 ambiguous/flat texture,2 clear coherent material,3 convincing characteristic light/structure
aesthetics.design_finish: 0 broken,1 rough/obscuring,2 clean coherent legible,3 polished
aesthetics.substantive_change: 0 background only,1 recolor/flat texture only,2 bar bodies reconstructed with material-specific structure/shading,3 designed physical objects
aesthetics.joint_rule: all numeric/text/axis pass AND all three aesthetic dimensions >=2; ambiguous outline fails

spatial.corner_correspondence: identify front bottom and front top matching vertex, plus left/right vertical edges as cross-check; each calibrated height within2units
spatial.projection: vertical edges parallel; all bases equal diamond footprint within +/-10px vertices (nominal halfdiagonals85/32); corresponding vertical corners within10px in x; generated axis calibration used
spatial.readability: front vertical edge correspondence clear, count/order/text correct; ambiguous correspondence => indeterminate => not pass
spatial.forbidden: do not compare maximum silhouette extents; footprint adds64px. Do not infer general perspective physical dimensions from single raster.

prerequisite: glass_v1 independently reviewed 20/20 jointly; measurements max error1.096 units
encoding: height only; orthographic yaw45 elevation22.115? exact elevation in geometry.json; equal square bases; centers at identical camera depth; vertical corners use generated axis calibration6.5px/unit nominal

prompts.glass_spatial_v1: 将<image1>中的四个准确三维几何体重新制作成精致蓝色厚玻璃实体。必须完全保持参考的相机投影、底部菱形足迹、顶面四角、所有竖直棱线的端点、各实体的宽度和深度。保持正交斜视，平行线不汇聚；四物体处于相同相机深度、同一地面，等正方形底面积，仅竖直高度编码甲20、乙70、丙40、丁90。沿用每根柱最前方竖直棱的上端与下端，用它对应左侧0到100轴；不可用整个外包框高度代替实体高度。重新设计为具有厚玻璃折射边壁、光学内部反射、通透内部与不同面的精致光照层次的真实物体，不能只换背景或叠加纹理。保留标题“测试数据”、四类别与四数值和左侧轴文字、位置和清晰度，不增删任何文字。背景简洁，柔和摄影棚光照，不能添加底座、脚或改变足迹。
